purpose: Track reusable SEC RAG skills, validation evidence, risk level, and stopping boundaries so optimization does not devolve into local benchmark patching.

promotion_requirements: Protected regression set must not regress.
Cross-company sanity set must not regress.
The skill must improve a named failure bucket or a documented target case.
The fix must be explainable from retrieved evidence or deterministic table facts.
Fresh rotating diagnostics are required before broad promotion when the skill was derived from old failures.
Blind holdout remains untouched until final validation.
stop_conditions: Stop after two consecutive iterations without target improvement.
Stop when the next fix requires company-specific fact registry entries rather than a general skill.
Stop when the improvement only comes from judge-noisy cases without deterministic evidence.
Stop when protected or cross-company gates regress.
Stop when adding one skill creates a composition conflict with an existing promoted skill.
Stop when the failure bucket is saturated and move to the next highest-risk bucket.

auto_approval_policy.eligible: Low-risk deterministic verifier or renderer with no retrieval-side change and clean gates.
auto_approval_policy.review_required: Any retrieval-policy, date-cutoff, abstention, fact-registry, or cross-skill composition change.
auto_approval_policy.blocked: Any change that hard-codes benchmark answers, hides uncertainty, or weakens protected gates.

protected_regression.name: Zeekr small30
protected_regression.role: Protect the known-good target-company sanity set.

development_diagnostic.name: Zeekr holdout20 diagnostic
development_diagnostic.role: Expose remaining high-risk failure buckets; not a final blind leaderboard.

cross_company_sanity.name: NVIDIA mini10
cross_company_sanity.role: Check that target-company skills do not become brittle Zeekr-only behavior.

rotating_diagnostic_pool.name: Skill evolution rotating diagnostics
rotating_diagnostic_pool.role: Refresh failure discovery and reduce overfitting to old diagnostics.

blind_holdout_pool.name: Skill evolution blind holdout candidates
blind_holdout_pool.role: Reserved final validation; do not use for skill generation.

skills.name: PageIndex Hybrid Retrieval
skills.goal: Use structural page/node evidence with hybrid retrieval and rescue so SEC answers receive enough source context.
trigger_conditions: SEC filing QA
long document evidence
tables and adjacent narrative are both likely needed
promotion_evidence: Target-company small30 reached 30/30 under the current fast chain.
NVIDIA mini10 sanity reached 9/10 and exposed a period-boundary issue rather than total retrieval collapse.
skills.boundary: Do not keep changing the main retrieval architecture unless protected plus rotating diagnostics show a repeated cross-bucket failure that cannot be handled by a narrower skill.

skills.name: Parameter Slimming / Cap2 Runtime Control
skills.goal: Reduce latency/cost while preserving the target-company correctness envelope.
trigger_conditions: default evaluation run
cost-sensitive validation
protected regression must remain stable
promotion_evidence: small30 remained 30/30 after slimming.
Runtime became reportable at roughly one minute per question on the protected set.
skills.boundary: Stop slimming once protected correctness stays stable but additional reductions risk context loss; future work should profile before cutting more retrieval evidence.

skills.name: Period-Aware Cutoff and Backfill
skills.goal: Prevent future leakage and recover period-correct evidence for historical SEC questions.
trigger_conditions: question names a quarter/year
retrieved later filing may override historical period
company event timeline has newer documents than the asked period
promotion_evidence: Period-boundary failures were observed on Zeekr and NVIDIA.
The mode is guarded because latest-information questions can legitimately need newer filings.
skills.boundary: Do not make cutoff stricter globally; keep it trigger-based and require review when a question does not specify a time boundary.

skills.name: Answer Coverage Repair
skills.goal: Repair recurring partial-answer omissions without changing evidence retrieval.
trigger_conditions: answer is factually consistent but misses a known required key point
repair fact can be sourced from existing evidence or a narrow deterministic rule
promotion_evidence: Useful for partial omissions, but it is more judge-sensitive than deterministic table facts.
skills.boundary: Do not expand into a broad company factbook until all general retrieval/table/period skills have been exercised.

skills.name: Period Answer Coverage Repair
skills.goal: Repair period-specific partial answers where the core fact is correct but required USD, YoY/QoQ, or period context is omitted.
trigger_conditions: question names an explicit year or quarter
question names a supported metric such as net profit/loss, R&D expense, or delivery volume
the missing item is a stable auditable period fact rather than a disputed metric definition
promotion_evidence: Targeted period cases q93, q94, q95, and q98 moved from 4 PARTIAL to 4 CORRECT.
Rotating20 moved from 8C/7P/5I after component mix to 12C/2P/6I after period coverage.
The only added incorrect in the judge rerun was q129, which was untouched by this skill and belongs to capitalization-table line-item reasoning.
Numeric gate remained 19 ALLOW / 1 REVIEW; the single review remains the known q129 capitalization case.
Registry protection validation after the source change found 52/52 artifacts and gate flow PASS.
skills.boundary: Do not broaden into a Zeekr factbook. Exclude disputed metric definitions such as q85, and prefer structural table/filing extraction before adding more curated coverage facts.

skills.name: Deterministic Table Verification and Repair
skills.goal: Verify and repair high-risk table-derived answers using parsed SEC table facts.
trigger_conditions: cash balance
quarterly R&D expenses
quarterly revenue breakdown
revenue contribution
delivery volume breakdown
promotion_evidence: holdout20 moved from about 5C/4P/11I to 9C/3P/8I in one judge rerun.
Repaired q57, q78, and q84 to table-gate PASS.
small30 gate remained 30/30 ALLOW.
NVIDIA mini10 gate remained 10/10 ALLOW.
skills.boundary: Only add new table fact types when they are structurally detectable across filings. Do not hard-code isolated answer text.

skills.name: Capitalization Table Line-Item Repair
skills.goal: Answer Actual / Pro Forma / Pro Forma as adjusted capitalization questions by comparing exact liability and equity line items from parsed SEC tables.
trigger_conditions: capitalization table with Actual, Pro Forma, and Pro Forma as adjusted columns
question asks whether changes are mainly liability reductions
line-item values are structurally detectable from parsed SEC table rows
promotion_evidence: Target q129 moved from INCORRECT to CORRECT with correctness score 5.0.
Rotating20 deterministic gate improved to 20 ALLOW / 0 REVIEW.
Full rotating20 judge after repair was 12C/3P/5I; q129 improved while q63 variance was unrelated to this repair.
Registry protection validation after the source change found 59/59 artifacts and gate flow PASS.
skills.boundary: Keep this skill limited to parsed capitalization tables. Source tie-breaking for multiple pro forma as adjusted filings must remain explicit and reviewable.

skills.name: Source Conflict / Discrepancy Reporting
skills.goal: Detect incompatible filing bases and answer with explicit discrepancy reporting instead of forcing one reconciled number.
trigger_conditions: delivery volume breakdown
monthly table and separate quarterly table disagree
same-looking metric appears under different reporting bases
promotion_evidence: q51 target judge moved to CORRECT after v2 wording.
small30 gate remained 30/30 ALLOW.
NVIDIA mini10 gate remained 10/10 ALLOW.
The repair states the filing mismatch instead of hiding it.
skills.boundary: Keep this skill discrepancy-focused. Do not use it to choose benchmark-preferred numbers unless both conflicting sources are shown.

skills.name: Component Mix Table Verification and Repair
skills.goal: Verify and repair annual cost-of-revenues and R&D expense component-mix answers using parsed SEC table rows.
trigger_conditions: cost of revenues mix across years
vehicle sales cost as a driver of total cost growth
R&D outsourcing versus employee compensation mix
annual component table with RMB values and percentage columns
promotion_evidence: q134 and q135 targeted judge reached 2/2 CORRECT after deterministic repair.
rotating20 improved from 6C/7P/7I to 8C/7P/5I.
rotating20 gate improved from 18 ALLOW / 2 REVIEW to 19 ALLOW / 1 REVIEW.
protected small30, development diagnostic, and NVIDIA mini10 lightweight gates remained PASS.
skills.boundary: Only use annual component-mix tables with structurally detectable RMB and percentage columns. Exclude interim tables and do not broaden into a company fact registry.

skills.name: Learning-Based Rescue Scorer
skills.goal: Replace hand-written rescue scoring with a trained candidate scorer after enough labeled failures exist.
trigger_conditions: retrieval candidates include both correct and distracting evidence
rule-based rescue cannot reliably rank evidence
promotion_evidence: Offline scorer exists as a candidate; it should not be promoted until rotating diagnostics and cross-company validation are run.
skills.boundary: Do not put a learned scorer into the main chain only because it improves one diagnostic bucket. Require separate train/dev split and cross-company validation.

skills.name: Company Fact Registry
skills.goal: Store narrow high-value company facts only after general skills stop yielding meaningful gains.
trigger_conditions: profile facts repeatedly fail despite correct evidence retrieval
facts are stable and client-relevant
manual or audited extraction is available
promotion_evidence: Not promoted. This is intentionally delayed to avoid turning the system into a Zeekr-only factbook too early.
skills.boundary: Use only after current general skills are frozen and only as a separately measurable optional layer.

skills.name: Skill Evolution MVP
skills.goal: Analyze failures, propose skill candidates, refresh testsets, and run promotion gates.
trigger_conditions: new judge results are available
a candidate skill is proposed
a validation report is needed
promotion_evidence: Existing analyzer, gate, and testset refresh create the basis for a future frontend.
skills.boundary: The meta-workflow should propose and validate skills; it should not auto-edit production code without a promotion decision.
